# C# Pure Static Atomic Output Template

Use this structure for every generated `<output_dir>/<Domain>/<AtomicName>.cs` file:

```csharp
// <auto-generated>
// Binary: server1/jx_linux_y
// Function: <SymbolName> @ <0xAddress>
// AtomicId: <domain.sub.atomic_name>
// </auto-generated>

using System;

namespace JxLinuxDiscovery.<Domain>;

/// <summary>
/// <Concise summary strictly from binary behavior.>
/// Binary Evidence: <binary> | <SymbolName> @ <0xAddress>
/// </summary>
public static class <AtomicClassName>
{
    public readonly record struct Input(
        // Explicit fields matching observed binary struct offsets & parameters
        // e.g. int SkillValue0 // KMagicAttrib::nValue[0] @ 0x...
    );

    public readonly record struct Output(
        // Explicit return values / mutated attrib fields
    );

    /// <summary>
    /// Pure static translation of <SymbolName> (<0xAddress>).
    /// </summary>
    public static Output Execute(in Input input)
    {
        // Exact integer arithmetic, bitmasks, branches, and clamps from decompile.
        // If an un-decompiled callee is required on a branch:
        // UNRESOLVED_BINARY_REF: <CalleeName> @ <0xAddr> -> inject Func<...> or throw NotImplementedException("UNRESOLVED_BINARY_REF: ...")
        throw new NotImplementedException();
    }
}
```
